description:
Get EDGAR financials as-of a date or time

Return normalized EDGAR financial statements as known at a date or an exact time.

Each statement carries its figures as values, one decimal string per metric code for the statement's own period and consolidated entity, with units beside them. detail=true adds each statement's facts, per-metric provenance and quality block, and the snapshot's reconciliation and data-quality summaries in _meta.

A date (YYYY-MM-DD) includes every filing the SEC dated on or before it. EDGAR dates a filing accepted after 5:30 pm Eastern the next business day, so a filing made after the close is not known on the day it was accepted.

A timestamp with an offset (for example 2023-11-02T16:00:00-04:00) includes every filing the SEC accepted at or before that instant.

Deterministic ordering for statements: statement_type, accounting_standard, statement_date, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, currency, is_restated, accession_id.

This route returns every statement of the selection. To return only some, by statement type, fiscal year range or fiscal period, with a limit, use GET /v1/edgar/as-of/{date}/financials/{cik}/page.

The response carries snapshot_hash and verify_url, which anyone can check without a key at GET /v1/query/verify-snapshot/{snapshot_hash}. It carries no replay token: mint one for the same read with POST /v1/query/execute and query type financials_as_of.

audit_mode.description: When true, a period with a restated statement also returns the statement as first reported, so the two can be compared. Default false returns one statement per period: the latest restatement admitted at the as-of date.

cik.description: Company CIK as digits (for example 0000320193), or a ticker symbol (for example AAPL). A ticker resolves to the company whose filings hold its statements as of the request's as-of or period-end date, or as of today when the request has none.

date.description: A date (YYYY-MM-DD), which includes filings the SEC dated on or before it, or a timestamp with an offset, which includes filings the SEC accepted at or before it.

detail.description: When false (the default), each statement carries its figures as values and units, one entry per metric. When true, each statement also carries content (its facts with their dimensions, periods and per-metric provenance) and its quality block. The snapshot's _meta reconciliation and data-quality summaries are returned only when true.

include_usd.description: When true, each fact also carries usd: its value in US dollars, with the rate, the rate's dates and its source. A value over a period (income and cash-flow statements) converts at the average of the Federal Reserve Board's H.10 daily rates over that period; a balance-sheet value at the rate on its date. value stays as filed. Default false.

name: edgar_as_of_financials
